portal_hypertension.title: Overlap of Primary Biliary Cholangitis and Systemic Sclerosis: A Case of Reynolds Syndrome.
portal_hypertension.authors: Gohar A, Abid I, Fatima SE
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：对于持续胆汁淤积性肝酶的 CREST 患者，应怀疑雷诺综合征，因为延迟诊断会导致门脉高压和静脉曲张出血。 临床提示：早期抗线粒体抗体筛查和及时熊去氧胆酸治疗可改善预后，这些患者需要对肺部和甲状腺疾病进行多学科随访。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Reynolds Syndrome should be suspected in CREST patients with persistent cholestatic liver enzymes, since delayed diagnosis allows portal hypertension and variceal bleeding to develop. Early anti-mitochondrial antibody screening and prompt ursodeoxycholic acid therapy improve outcomes, and these patients need multidisciplinary follow-up for lung and thyroid disease.

portal_hypertension.title: Cumulative Metformin Use and Hepatocellular Carcinoma Risk After HCV SVR: A Multicentre Cohort Study.
portal_hypertension.journal: Liver international : official journal of the International Association for the Study of the Liver
portal_hypertension.authors: Calvo-Sánchez H, Jara-Fernández L, Encijo-Heredia R
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于多中心临床研究（样本量约为 1531）。核心观点：尽管丙型肝炎病毒治疗后的持续病毒学应答（SVR）可降低肝细胞癌（HCC）的发病率，但残留风险仍然存在。 临床提示：二甲双胍与较低的 HCC 风险相关，但累积二甲双胍暴露 (CME) 是否会降低 SVR 后的风险仍不清楚。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Although sustained virological response (SVR) after hepatitis C virus treatment reduces hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) incidence, residual risk persists. Metformin has been associated with lower HCC risk, but whether cumulative metformin exposure (CME) lowers post-SVR risk remains unclear. We evaluated whether CME was associated with lower HCC risk after SVR. We analysed a multicentre cohort of 1531 patients who achieved SVR after direct-acting antiviral therapy (median follow-up, 75.5 months). Metformin exposure was modelled as a time-updated cumulative variable in start-stop Cox models to control for immortal-time bias. portal_hypertension.title: Refining the role of liver transplantation as a curative treatment for hepatocellular carcinoma.
portal_hypertension.authors: Yoh T, Ito T, Ogiso S
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：虽然LR在肝功能保留的患者中被广泛接受，但其疗效受到术后肝代偿失调风险和相对较高的复发率的限制。 临床提示：肝切除（LR）和肝移植（LT）是公认的肝细胞癌（HCC）“治愈”疗法，各自都有优点和局限性。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Liver resection (LR) and liver transplantation (LT) are well-established "curative" treatments for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), each with advantages and limitations. While LR is widely accepted for patients with preserved liver function, its efficacy is constrained by the risk of postoperative hepatic decompensation and a relatively high recurrence rate. In contrast, LT offers a comprehensive cure by addressing both the tumor itself and underlying liver disease; however, its clinical application is limited by donor shortages, immunosuppression-related complications, and perioperative risks. Recent advancements in perioperative care and immunosuppressive strategies have improved LT outcome...

portal_hypertension.title: Outcomes of splenic artery embolization in patients with portal hypertension: a single center experience.
portal_hypertension.authors: Waern J, Hreinsson JP, Mahdavian A
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：肝硬化（CPH）和非肝硬化门静脉高压（​​NCPH）可导致严重的并发症，包括静脉曲张出血、腹水和脾功能亢进。 临床提示：然而，关于脾动脉栓塞（SAE）对门静脉高压症的长期临床影响的证据仍然有限。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Cirrhotic (CPH) and non-cirrhotic portal hypertension (NCPH) can result in severe complications, including variceal bleeding, ascites, and hypersplenism. However, evidence regarding the long-term clinical impact of splenic artery embolization (SAE) in portal hypertension remains limited. We conducted a retrospective single-center study including consecutive patients who underwent SAE for complications of portal hypertension at Sahlgrenska University Hospital, Gothenburg, Sweden, between January 2016 and December 2024. Clinical, radiological, and laboratory data were collected at baseline and during follow-up. Overall survival, gastrointestinal bleeding, complications, and changes in clinical...

portal_hypertension.title: Endoscopic variceal ligation-induced ulcer bleeding: incidence by indication, real-world treatment, and outcomes.
portal_hypertension.authors: Vasilakis T, Schauer S, Grajecki D
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：内镜下静脉曲张结扎术（EVL）引起的溃疡出血是一种罕见但可能危及生命的并发症。 临床提示：虽然选择性和紧急 EVL 的发生率已有报道，但尚未单独检查住院期间因肝硬化急性失代偿而进行的半选择性手术。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Endoscopic variceal ligation (EVL) - induced ulcer bleeding is a rare but potentially life-threatening complication. While the incidence following elective and emergency EVL has been reported, semi-elective procedures performed during hospitalization for acute decompensation of cirrhosis have not been separately examined. Additionally, real-world data on endoscopic treatment strategies, hemostasis rates and outcomes are scarce. We conducted a retrospective cohort study analyzing all ligation procedures performed in adults with portal hypertension and esophageal varices at Charité University Hospital, Campus Virchow and Campus Mitte, from 01/01/2016 until 06/30/2023.
